value.title: Outrun - Continuous Lactate Monitoring
value.description: Outrun is building the world's first continuous, wearable lactate monitor for athletes. STUD-ENT grantee 2026 - 1M NOK from Innovasjon Norge. Born from gold-medal iGEM research at the University of Oslo.
value.main_text_excerpt:
What is continuous lactate monitoring?
Continuous lactate monitoring means tracking lactate trends throughout a training session instead of relying on a single blood sample. Outrun is developing a wearable patch approach so athletes and coaches can see intensity changes while training is still underway.

structured_organisations.name: Outrun
structured_organisations.description: Outrun is a Norwegian sportstech company building a wearable biosensor patch for continuous lactate monitoring during training. The patch is designed to stream intensity data to a companion app and compatible wearables without finger-prick blood tests.

external_observations.evidence_span: Great selection in a small space and open on Sundays! Good, friendly service. Got what I needed, very pleased.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: This place has very helpful and friendly staff and a huge selection of good running shoes. The Currex insoles they sell are also amazing 👍👍

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Sunday 4 o clock in the afternoon, i entered, i said hi, i went to the basement to try some shoes... I was waiting 10 minutes and nobody came although they knew i was waiting. I just left.... it's amazing how young people don't give a shit about anything nowadays

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: An absolutely amazing store with a great variety of trainers & sport equipment from multiple brands for multiple sports with a focus on running. Stuff is very friendly and helpful and they guide you in accordance to your needs. Also, a very big plus is that the store is open on Sundays till late. In other words this store simply “outruns” the competition.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Very nice shoe store. Knowledgeable workers, great equipment, and a treadmill downstairs to even run with the shoe options to make sure it feels right.
